name: [3114] Playable SCPs
desc:
Playable SCPs is a full rebuild of the original game Playable SCPs: Legacy with a lot more polish, content and rewriting.

Become an SCP, a NPC or a Dummy and earn points by beating other entities to buy more characters.

The game went public very early due to being discontinued at a time, so the game is in alpha stage and has barely anything done. Experience might be unstable.

This game is heavily inspired by HOURS.


Game is originally created and developed by @she_speakslua, but is now being updated by @kichasiekdjjsjsjdjfj
The first (original) game: https://www.roblox.com/games/6886268594

      FolderName = nil, -- Create a custom folder for your hub/game

      Enabled = false, -- Prompt the user to join your Discord server if their executor supports it

      Title = "Untitled",
      Subtitle = "Key System",
      Note = "No method of obtaining the key is provided", -- Use this to tell the user how to get a key
      FileName = "Key", -- It is recommended to use something unique, as other scripts using Rayfield may overwrite your key file
